key_findings: Narrative review: Hippo pathway dysregulation with sustained YAP/TAZ activation is linked to proliferation, fibrosis and progesterone resistance in endometriosis; no Hippo-targeted therapy is clinically validated.
Ectopic endometrium shows increased YAP/TAZ with reduced MOB1, SAV1, LATS1 and LATS2.
